outcome: Make it impossible for project agents to ignore explicit instructions by converting instruction-obedience and completion-reporting into typed pydantic-validated contracts, deterministic extension gates, and retained agentic evals; prose is display only and cannot decide success.

primary_proof.command: cd /home/graham/workspace/experiments/agent-skills && uv run --with pydantic python3 skills/shame/scripts/immutable_goal_schema.py validate skills/shame/immutable_goal.json && skills/agentic-evals/run.sh run skills/shame/fixtures/agentic_eval.json --output /tmp/shame-agentic-eval.json
primary_proof.expected: validator exits 0 and agentic-evals reports READY with zero FAIL/BLOCKED cases

completion_criteria: Every guarded project-agent completion report ends with one pydantic-valid pi.agent_status.v1 JSON object.
A valid status object cannot encode done with hidden unfinished work, ambiguous failure labels, missing state payloads, missing changed, or done without verified/proof fields.
A valid status object cannot rely on model-authored prose for status truth; the extension renders the visible Status Report from validated JSON.
A valid status object with not_done is only legal as state=continuing and must carry not_done[0].next_command for deterministic follow-up.
Retained agentic-evals fail if status validity returns to regex/prose policy or if the pydantic contract is weakened.
Boundary handoffs use pi.receipt_envelope.v1 or owner-specific typed receipts where authority changes.
A done status with local proof must cite existing proof artifacts, known JSON proof receipts must validate, and verified command/result pairs must be backed by proof text.
Escalation evidence uses typed parent_refs rather than ad hoc receipt path strings.
Ecosystem membership is represented as pydantic-valid agent_ecosystem.membership.v1 data.
allowed_scope: skills/triage-error/failure_codes.json when new canonical failure codes are required
ask/tau/project-watchdog/ops-herdr integration points only when needed to carry typed status, receipts, or continuation ledgers
forbidden_drift: Do not replace pydantic validation with LLM judgment, regex status policy, or model-authored prose checks.
Do not treat commit, push, branch, issue, or reviewer prose as completion proof without a typed status object and readback evidence.
Do not add dashboards, reports, or classifier loops before the deterministic status contract and retained evals pass.
Do not bypass a rejected status by disabling the guard, deleting eval cases, or weakening schema fields.

retry_stop_rule.stop_condition: If the same blocker survives two focused attempts, emit state=needs_human with one exact question or state=failed with a triage-error code and proof artifacts; do not keep retrying from stale context.

must: MUST treat explicit operator instructions as standing constraints.
MUST end guarded mutating or self-correction turns with one valid pi.agent_status.v1 JSON object.
MUST use state=continuing with not_done[0].next_command when agent-executable work remains.
MUST use state=needs_human only for one exact human action and state=failed only with a triage-error code.
MUST not claim completion from prose, commits, pushes, tests, or reviewer opinion without typed evidence.
MUST own pi.agent_status.v1 and this immutable goal contract.
MUST record human labels as training examples with readback through Memory when enabled.
MUST require retained agentic-evals for every enforcement change.
MUST keep prose display subordinate to pydantic-valid status data.
MUST reject missing, invalid, duplicate-key, or trailing-content status JSON on guarded turns.
MUST strip model-authored status prose and raw JSON from accepted output.
MUST render the visible Status Report from validated pi.agent_status.v1 data.
MUST queue compiled continuing or needs_* follow-up commands deterministically.
MUST write pending review packets for rejected candidates.
MUST only extract the final status JSON, reject duplicate keys/trailing content, and invoke the pydantic validator.
MUST NOT decide status truth from regexes, prose headings, markdown, HTML, or LLM judgment.
MUST return the validated status object to the extension renderer.
MUST use pydantic with extra=forbid.
MUST make invalid states unrepresentable: done needs verified/proof and empty not_done; continuing needs not_done[].next_command; not_done is only legal with continuing.
MUST reject ambiguous failure labels unless they are triage-error catalog codes or deterministic minted *_unclassified_<8hex> codes.
MUST keep changed non-empty for every report.
MUST reject missing local proof paths for done reports.
MUST reject known JSON proof receipts that do not pass schema-specific checks.
MUST reject verified command/result pairs that are not backed by local proof text when local proof is supplied.
MUST require needs_webgpt parent_refs rather than ad hoc receipt path fields.
MUST compile continuing and needs_* payloads into exact runnable commands with no interpretation.
MUST compile done, needs_human, and failed to no automatic command.
MUST fail if regex/prose status policy returns.
MUST fail if pydantic status invariants are weakened.
MUST include real_world deterministic cases for extension, schema, compiler, and Memory-backed label capture paths.
MUST publish component ownership and authority boundaries.
MUST use pi.receipt_envelope.v1 for authority-changing dispatch, handoff, acceptance, escalation, closure, and durable failure.
MUST state that pydantic proves structure and consumers must separately resolve referenced evidence.
MUST publish and validate agent_ecosystem.membership.v1 as the machine-readable membership source.
MUST own the canonical failure-code vocabulary.
MUST mint deterministic *_unclassified_<8hex> codes for unmatched signals.
MUST prevent generic terminal failure labels from becoming valid ecosystem decisions.
MUST consume typed needs_* status payloads instead of informal escalation prose.
MUST compile escalation requests into typed Tau DAG contracts or recovery packets.
MUST own immutable goal hashes and DAG acceptance receipts.
MUST emit typed node receipts and handoffs that can embed or reference pi.agent_status.v1.
MUST not let reviewer prose replace acceptance receipts.
MUST create/read continuation ledgers, proof gates, and locks for active project work.
MUST prevent done reports when machine-readable tickets, gates, or next steps remain unresolved.
MUST route durable failures through typed triage/status receipts.
MUST write pydantic-valid lazy_report_shame.continuation_guard.v1 ledgers through the shame guard contract when machine-readable work remains.
MUST transport cross-session state through typed inbox/dead-letter records.
MUST use triage-error codes for dead letters rather than vague blocked prose.
MUST store shame training examples, triage resolutions, and project knowledge with readback.
MUST treat recalls as observations, not completion receipts.
MUST not be used to bypass typed status validation.
MUST shape generation toward minimal code only.
MUST not override pydantic status, receipt, proof, or eval requirements.
MUST define proof surface, completion criteria, allowed scope, forbidden drift, retry budget, and stop condition for this immutable goal.
MUST keep success tied to observed behavior rather than agent activity.

final_report_rule: A final report may claim this immutable goal is met only after the primary proof passes and the report cites the produced eval artifact plus any remaining proof-boundary limitations.
